papers.title: Combined use of Intravenous and Topical Tranexamic Acid following Cementless Total Hip Arthroplasty: A Randomised Clinical Trial
papers.abstract: PURPOSE: This study was designed to compare the efficacy and safety of the combined use of tranexamic acid (TXA) with the intravenous (IV) or local use alone in total hip arthroplasty (THA). METHODS: 210 patients were randomised to a IV group, a local group or a combined group. Participants received 1.5 g IV-TXA in the IV group, 3 g local TXA in the local group, or 1 g IV-TXA combined with 2 g local TXA in the combined group. The primary outcomes were total blood loss (TBL), maximum haemoglobin drop, and the incidence of deep venous thrombosis (DVT) and pulmonary embolism (PE). RESULTS: TBL was (776.75 ± 188.95) ml in the combined group, which was significantly lower than in the IV group or the local group (p = 0.015, p = 0.001 respectively). Likewise, the mean values of maximum hemoglobin drop in the combined, IV, and local groups were 2.98 ± 0.78, 3.36 ± 0.78, and 3.89 ± 0.72 g/dL, respectively, with a significant intergroup difference (p<0.001 for all). Asymptomatic DVT was detected in 1 patient of the IV group, and 2 patients of the combined group with the use of ultrasound. There were no episodes of PE, and no significant differences were seen between groups in terms of complications. CONCLUSIONS: Combined use of intravenous TXA and local TXA in primary unilateral THA can effectively decrease total blood loss and increase postoperative haemoglobin levels without influencing complication rates. It is suggested that this combined TXA regimen is more effective in decreasing blood loss in cementeless THA than intravenous or local administration alone.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文是关于全髋关节置换术中使用氨甲环酸减少出血的临床试验，与生物力学、应力遮挡或微动完全无关。
llm.why_not_core: The paper is a clinical trial on pharmacological blood loss reduction; it contains no biomechanical modeling, no implant stress analysis, no micromotion quantification, and no FEA.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较联合使用静脉和局部氨甲环酸在全髋关节置换术中减少出血的效果。
summary_zh.method: 随机对照试验，分别使用静脉、局部或联合给药，测量总出血量和血红蛋白下降。
summary_zh.result: 联合用药组总出血量和血红蛋白下降显著低于单独用药组，并发症无差异。
summary_zh.validation: 210例患者的随机对照临床验证。

summary_en.motivation: To compare the efficacy and safety of combined intravenous and topical tranexamic acid versus either alone in total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: A randomized clinical trial with three groups: intravenous only, topical only, and combined, measuring total blood loss and hemoglobin drop.
summary_en.result: The combination group showed significantly lower total blood loss and hemoglobin drop compared to the other groups, with no increase in complications.
summary_en.validation: Clinical validation with 210 patients in a randomized controlled trial.

papers.title: Four-Year Results of Summit Stems for Total Hip Arthroplasty in Japanese Patients
papers.abstract: Purpose A retrospective study to evaluate the clinical and radiographic outcome of the Summit primary total hip arthroplasty (THA) at a minimum follow-up of 4 years. Methods 87 hips in 84 Japanese patients underwent THA using Summit stems. 3 patients were lost to follow-up, and 4 patients were excluded because a Summit stem was judged to be inappropriate for their narrow femoral canals. The remaining 80 hips in 77 patients were evaluated. Mean age was 66 years (range, 33-86 y). Mean postoperative follow-up period was 52 months (range, 48-66 m). Results There was no early stem subsidence after surgery. Of the 80 hips, 60 (75%) showed radiographic signs of stem osseointegration including zones 3 and 5 at final follow-up. Stress shielding occurred in 50 hips (62.5%), and third-degree stress shielding was observed in 12 hips (15%). 3 patients experienced postoperative thigh pain due to distal fixation. Conclusions These short-term results indicate that the Summit stem achieved good initial fixation, although there were some cases of distal fixation. Careful long-term follow-up and observation will be necessary for hips in which stress shielding occurs.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文报告了Summit股骨柄在日本人患者中的临床与影像学结果，涉及应力遮挡和骨整合，但未进行有限元分析或应力/微动的定量测量。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a clinical outcome study without any biomechanical modeling, FEA, or quantitative stress/strain/micromotion data in Gruen zones.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估Summit股骨柄在日本人患者中至少4年的临床与影像学结果。
summary_zh.method: 对84例患者87髋行Summit柄THA，随访平均52个月，分析X线片和临床评分。
summary_zh.result: 80髋中60髋（75%）显示骨整合，应力遮挡发生率62.5%，15%为三度遮挡。
summary_zh.validation: 回顾性临床研究，通过X线片评估骨整合与应力遮挡分级。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the clinical and radiographic outcome of Summit femoral stems in Japanese patients with a minimum follow-up of 4 years.
summary_en.method: A retrospective study of 87 hips in 84 patients undergoing Summit stem THA, with radiographic analysis for osseointegration and stress shielding.
summary_en.result: Osseointegration was observed in 75% of hips, and stress shielding occurred in 62.5%, with 15% classified as third-degree.
summary_en.validation: Clinical follow-up with radiographs at a mean of 52 months, using Gruen zone analysis for osseointegration and Engh's classification for stress shielding.
